locations.label: Power House switch
locations.description: Open the route through Nuketown to the Power House in the Cul-de-sac and turn on its switch. Enter the bunker, reach Generators and interact with the ventilation console. Gather the team there and survive the lockdown. On the surface, find the four houses releasing green gas and hold interact on each affected ventilation unit until its gauge reaches green. Pack-a-Punch opens in Beds. This marker identifies the named region on a diagram, not a measured object coordinate.

locations.label: Rushmore terminal
locations.description: After opening Pack-a-Punch, advance one round and interact with Rushmore in Operations. Buy Galvaknuckles from the red truck in the Cul-de-sac. Build Telepads before the timed server task; their full part route is below. Prepare a Pack-a-Punched weapon with Brain Rot for the painting step. locations.label: Green House Upstairs bench
locations.description: Collect one Riot Shield part from each of the three search areas below, then craft it at Green House Upstairs or APD Control. Keep a fresh shield for the mannequin defenses and the Avogadro’s ranged attacks. Cul-de-sac: rear driver-side bus wheel, front driver-side wheel of the green car, or beneath the couch in the debris near the truck. Operations: filing cabinet in the garage, ground-floor desk with green monitors, or upstairs filing cabinet. Beds: cardboard boxes on a shelf, dresser beside the barrier, or chair near the toppled shelf. This marker identifies the named region on a diagram, not a measured object coordinate.

Cul-de-sac: rear driver-side bus wheel, front driver-side wheel of the green car, or beneath the couch in the debris near the truck. Operations: filing cabinet in the garage, ground-floor desk with green monitors, or upstairs filing cabinet. Beds: cardboard boxes on a shelf, dresser beside the barrier, or chair near the toppled shelf. This marker identifies the named region on a diagram, not a measured object coordinate.

locations.label: Ray Gun Mark II variant bench
locations.description: The clock sequence opens the Operations locker containing an upgraded standard Mark II. For an elemental variant, first collect the assembly kit parts below and build its workbench in Operations Upstairs. Tubing, Yellow House: downstairs kitchen table, upstairs lamp table, or upstairs bookshelf. Canister, Storage: shelf, barrel by the Generators tunnel, or barrel by the exit. Container, APD Control / Solitary: cart near the Mystery Box, chair by the APD Control terminal, or Solitary desk beside the seated mannequin. This marker identifies the named region on a diagram, not a measured object coordinate.

locations.label: Power House server core
locations.description: Before lifting the server, place one Telepad in Power House and its partner in Prisoner Holding. Lure a Jolting Jack into firing electricity at the Power House server to unlock the core. Take it, use the prepared teleporter immediately, sprint to Operations and install it in the server slot before its countdown expires. This marker identifies the named region on a diagram, not a measured object coordinate.
